_readme: IMMUTABLE. This file is the contract: which variables exist, which templates render, and the rules. Do not edit for environment changes — edit variables.json. CI fails any PR that modifies this file without the 'main-json-change' label.

secrets_never_in_repo: GitHub PAT (entered in the SMUS connection UI, stored by AWS)
rules.note: Any variables.json value that begins with the unset marker is treated as not yet set; render fails on it. This is deliberate — a template must never render with a placeholder inside.

ACCOUNT_ID.description: AWS account ID (12 digits). Not a secret, but not a template literal either.

REGION.description: Region for all Track A resources. Domain, S3, Redshift, Glue must match.

PROJECT_ID.description: Pilot project ID inside the domain.

SNAPSHOT_PREFIX.description: Prefix under the bucket for daily Parquet snapshots.

GLUE_DATABASE.description: Sandbox Glue catalog database for snapshot external tables.

REDSHIFT_WORKGROUP_ID.description: Pilot Redshift Serverless workgroup ID (datashare consumer).

PILOT_GROUP.description: IAM group driving S3 access and SMUS membership. Not usable as an LF principal.

TEST_USER.description: Working identity that proves the pilot access path.

EXEC_ROLE.description: Domain execution role (carries the project-user permissions boundary).

DOMAIN_MANAGE_ROLE.description: Domain management role created with the domain.

GITHUB_REPO.description: org/repo for the SMUS GitHub connection.

EMR_SERVERLESS_APP_ID.description: EMR Serverless application backing the project's serverless.spark connection (Spark kernel prerequisite).

CONSUMER_NAMESPACE.description: Sandbox Redshift Serverless consumer namespace (datashare granted here, not production).

secrets._rule: Entries here name WHERE a secret lives, never WHAT it is. Allowed keys per entry: store, ref. No 'value' key is ever permitted.

github_pat.ref: Entered once in SMUS → Project → Settings → Connections → GitHub. Held by AWS, never in this repo.

controls.VCS-1: All Track A code under GitHub version control via the SMUS connection, from V1 onward.
controls.REPRO-1: Pipeline reproducible from a clean checkout — config-as-code, no hardcoded credentials.
controls.REVIEW-1: All changes land via small PRs with sign-off; no direct-to-main commits.
